pumi.events.v1.ModelRoleSwitched.Limit.j.description:
Limit is the run that the provider's usage or rate limit stopped: its
 adapter and model.
pumi.events.v1.ModelRoleSwitched.Limit.j.title: Limit

pumi.events.v1.ModelRoleSwitched.jsonsch.description:
ModelRoleSwitched is the data of dev.getpumi.model_role.switched: a model
 role switched to its fallback on another adapter, because the provider's
 usage or rate limit stopped a run of the role, or a person switched it
 back (decision 0246). The role stays where its last switch put it, for
 every later invocation of every plan, until the next switch. A switch to
 the fallback names the invocation and the limit, and a switch back names
 the person; exactly one of invocation and switched_by is set.

^(switched_by)$.description: The person who switched the role back.

adapter.description: The adapter that the role switched to.

invocation.description:
The invocation whose run the limit stopped, for a switch to the
 fallback.

limit.description:
The limit that caused the switch to the fallback, or, for a switch
 back, the limit of the switch that it undoes.

model.description: The model that the role switched to.

role.description: The model role, such as implementer.

switchedBy.description: The person who switched the role back.

pumi.events.v1.ModelRoleSwitched.jsonsch.title: Model Role Switched
